protocol.timed_region: Fresh process through exit, including initialization/JIT and complete PBM output to a temporary regular file. Excludes AOT builds and output validation.
protocol.full_input_reference: locally compiled unmodified Rust #4; every candidate additionally compared with full image; differing pixels retained and reported
protocol.source_metric: Comment removal, whitespace collapse, UTF-8, gzip level 1 with mtime=0; also nonblank noncomment physical LOC. Local metric, not guaranteed CLBG gz.
protocol.source_scope: Mech program .mec only; coordinate mapping, recurrence and termination all in Mech. Generic native map/thread/PBM runtime and compiler excluded. Competitors: complete unchanged upstream programs.
protocol.floating_point: Native C/C++ disables contraction; fastmath configurations explicitly relax IEEE semantics; LLVM also tests fastmath with contraction disabled. Go tests default and compiler -d=fmahash=n. Mech FMA opt-in. Official N=200 requires byte equality; larger images record exact equality and differing pixel count.
protocol.threads: Runtime controls request the chosen worker count where supported; each row records actual source worker policy. Fixed or automatic policies remain unmodified.
protocol.status: full-input confirmation and runtime configuration study; selected endpoints
protocol.selection: Fastest baseline build for every language, all five baseline Mech builds, Chapel #3 chunk sizes 64/512/4096 and Mech demand scheduling. Smallest competitor sources are not remeasured in this study.
